name: Alex Trost / Frontend Horse
text:
Hi Alex,

The retro-style UI example in Frontend Horse issue 78 prompted this suggestion. I make Take The Wall: a shared page where the next activated takeover replaces the previous owner.

Its free designer lets people arrange a message or project and switch desktop/mobile previews. The CSS angle is container-sized typography: a preview inside a dialog needs to respond to its own width, not the browser viewport.

https://www.takethewall.com/?take=1

Could the designer fit a creative-web feature? This is a topic suggestion, not a paid placement request. Previewing is free; live publication uses paid checkout or reviewed free email entry. No promised display duration or audience.

Take The Wall
